definitions.explanation: A person or thing that perfectly represents a particular type or category.

examples.japanese: これは{日本|にほん}{家屋|かおく}の{典型|てんけい}だ。
examples.english: This is a typical Japanese house.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{典型|てんけい}的|てき}なサラリーマンだ。
examples.english: He is a typical company employee.

examples.japanese: {典型|てんけい}的|てき}な{間違|まちが}いを{避|さ}ける。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{典型|てんけい}的|てき}な〜 (typical ~, classic ~)
・〜の{典型|てんけい} (a typical example of ~)

COMMON USES:
・{典型|てんけい}的|てき}な{例|れい} (typical example)
・{典型|てんけい}的|てき}な{日本人|にほんじん} (typical Japanese person)
・{典型|てんけい}的|てき}な{症状|しょうじょう} (typical symptoms)

USAGE NOTE:
{典型|てんけい}的|てき} is very commonly used as a na-adjective to mean "typical" or "classic."
